title: Why Low-Delta Trades Are More Dangerous Than They Look
speaker: Gad and Sahil Malhotra (tastylive research team)

macro_themes.view: Selling lower-delta SPY strangles raises win rate (67% to 84%) but the worst loss per dollar of credit grows from 2.3x to 7.5x; in 2026 5-delta strangles have lost money.
SPX is more active intraday than before 2020 but calmer than 2020-2023; daily highs now tend to come mid-day, so 0DTE trades are best closed around 11:00-12:00 CT.

notes: Educational options-research segment with no directional calls. Date from 'on Friday' (Friday Oct 16, 2026; listing approx 2026-10-17). recorded_when 'intraday' assumed because it's a live tastylive show. video_type set to daily_market as the closest category.
